context: Planning subscription eligibility on existing users and workers under an explicit policy, without changing app behavior or architecture.

checklist.name: trusted_activation
checklist.description: Removes redirect/query authority; maps verified provider subscription/customer/price facts and merchant/environment to the existing user; uses backend native owner permission plus derived paid eligibility.

checklist.name: policy_and_freshness
checklist.description: Retains paid-through scheduled-cancellation access and free sign-in/read; enforces both 10-minute freshness and cutoff; missing/stale facts require bounded authoritative refresh or pending/denied, and failure never advances verifiedAt or adds grace.

checklist.name: worker_authority
checklist.description: Checks current ownership/account state and eligibility before subsequent chargeable stages and result commit; prevents a frozen enqueue decision bypassing invalidation; explicit resume avoids silently publishing backlog.

checklist.name: convergence_and_reuse
checklist.description: Reuses the canonical user mapping, provider portal/retries and local verified facts; handles duplicate/reordered events and racing refresh with conditional revision/current-state reconciliation; avoids repeated provider inventory for fresh ordinary guards and new ledgers/role systems.

checklist.name: checks_and_limits
checklist.description: Maps the supplied operations to concrete activation/spoofing/cross-owner/cutoff/outage/race checks, including zero refresh for fresh repeated ordinary guards; labels proposals and checks unrun and does not claim live provider evidence.
